channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: North Korea fires missiles as row over landmine blast intensifies
item.description: Seoul accuses Pyongyang of causing a landmine explosion that injured three of its soldiers, an accusation North denies.

item.title: Strikes on Darfur market in Sudan killed more than 100, rights group says
item.description: Women and children killed as witnesses say attack struck civilian shopkeepers, RSF fighters.

item.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show
item.description: With 85% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its allies are set to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset.

item.title: Serbian shot dead after attacking officer outside Israeli embassy, minister says
item.description: Authorities say the attacker in Belgrade was an underage male who was being monitored by security services.

item.title: Watch: At the scene of Spain's deadly train crash
item.description: People have been killed after a Spanish high-speed train collided with another train south of the capital Madrid, making this the country's worst disaster since 2013.

item.title: Israel's election result is messy - here's why
item.description: Despite having the highest voter turnout in nearly three decades, Israel's elections have had no clear winner. What does this mean for the country, asks the BBC's Yolande Knell.

item.title: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios
item.description: With 85% of votes counted, all signs point to an impasse. The most likely outcome may be new elections.

item.title: Israel's election deadlock is a sign of the country's deep divisions
item.description: The election was a celebration of democracy in some ways - but it has left Israel with no clear path to a new government, writes James Landale.
